ai.literal: Do not begin any action, do not underestimate (the enemy) completely, except after having found the suitable place.
ai.translation: Do not embark on any undertaking, nor underestimate your opponent, until you have identified a suitable place to act.
ai.modern: பொருத்தமான இடத்தைக் கண்டறிவதற்கு முன், எந்தச் செயலையும் தொடங்கக் கூடாது; பகைவரை எளியவர் என்று இகழவும் கூடாது.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme importance of choosing the right location before taking action. The author advises against two critical errors: starting an endeavor prematurely (தொடங்கற்க) and underestimating the opposition (எள்ளற்க). Both of these cautions must be observed until a strategic, advantageous place (இடம்) has been thoroughly identified. The word 'முற்றும்' emphasizes that one should not dismiss any aspect of the enemy's strength until the terrain is in one's favor.

ai.literal: Even to those of hostile strength, relying on a fortress, the resulting success will yield many benefits.
ai.translation: Even for those who possess aggressive strength, securing a proper stronghold and acting from it will yield many advantages.
ai.modern: பகைமை கொண்ட வலிமை உடையவர்களுக்கும், ஒரு பாதுகாப்பான அரணைப் பற்றிக்கொண்டு செயல்படுவதால் உண்டாகும் நன்மைகள் பலவற்றைத் தரும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the strategic importance of choosing a proper place or stronghold, which is the theme of this chapter. Even warriors who possess immense physical strength and hostile power cannot rely on raw force alone. By securing a proper fortress or defensive position, they gain a strategic advantage that multiplies their power. Thus, acting from a secure base yields numerous benefits and ensures victory.

ai.literal: Even those who lack strength, having gathered strength, will conquer, the right place having known, against enemies, guarding themselves, if they act.
ai.translation: Even those who lack strength will gather strength and conquer their enemies, if they choose the right place, guard themselves well, and then act.
ai.modern: வலிமை இல்லாதவர்களும் கூட, தகுந்த இடத்தை அறிந்து, தங்களைப் பாதுகாத்துக் கொண்டு, பகைவர்களுக்கு எதிராகச் செயல்பட்டால், வலிமை பெற்று வெற்றி பெறுவார்கள்.
ai.explanation: This couplet emphasizes the power of choosing the right location in overcoming a stronger adversary. Even those who are naturally weak can defeat their enemies if they act with careful self-protection. The key lies in knowing the right place and preparing themselves adequately. By choosing a strategic location that favors them and disadvantages the enemy, the weak can neutralize the enemy's strength and emerge victorious.

ai.literal: Those who planned will lose their plans, if those who approach, having known the place and having closely approached, act.
ai.translation: Even those who have carefully planned an attack will lose their designs, if their opponents understand the terrain, closely secure their position, and act.
ai.modern: பகைவர்கள் தகுந்த இடத்தை அறிந்து, நெருங்கிச் செயல்பட்டால், அவர்களை வெல்ல எண்ணியவர்கள் தங்கள் எண்ணத்தை இழந்து தோற்பார்கள்.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme importance of choosing the right location in strategic endeavors. Even if an adversary has made elaborate plans to conquer, those plans will fail if the opposing side understands the terrain (இடனறிந்து), positions themselves closely and securely (துன்னி), and executes their actions (செயின்). The word 'துன்னியார்' refers to those who draw near to engage, and 'துன்னி' emphasizes the act of closely securing the strategic spot. Thus, strategic placement and timely action can completely dismantle the pre-planned schemes of any powerful opponent.

ai.literal: In deep water, conquers the crocodile; will destroy [it], from the water if [it] departs, other [creatures].
ai.translation: In deep water, a crocodile conquers all; but if it leaves the water, other creatures will easily destroy it.
ai.modern: ஆழமான நீரில் இருக்கும்போது முதலை மற்ற விலங்குகளை வெல்லும்; ஆனால் அது அந்நீரை விட்டு வெளியேறினால், பிற எளிய விலங்குகளும் அதனை வென்று அழித்துவிடும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme importance of choosing the right place for action. A crocodile is an unmatched predator when it remains in deep water, where its natural environment gives it absolute strength. However, if it leaves its watery domain, it loses its advantage and can be easily defeated even by otherwise weaker creatures. This analogy teaches that even the most powerful individuals can be easily overcome if they step out of their sphere of strength or act in an unfavorable environment.

ai.literal: Ocean will not run, wheel-strong tall chariot; ocean-running ship also will not run on land.
ai.translation: A mighty chariot with strong wheels cannot sail upon the ocean; and a ship that traverses the ocean cannot run upon the land.
ai.modern: வலிமையான சக்கரங்களைக் கொண்ட பெரிய தேர் கடலில் ஓடாது; கடலில் ஓடும் கப்பலும் நிலத்தில் ஓடாது.
ai.explanation: This couplet uses a powerful analogy to emphasize the importance of choosing the right place for action. A grand chariot, despite its strong wheels and speed, is completely useless on the ocean. Similarly, a massive ship, designed to conquer the deep seas, cannot move on dry land. Every entity has its own domain of power; one must identify and operate within the appropriate sphere to achieve success.

ai.literal: Fearlessness other than support is not needed, without omission having planned, from a suitable place if one acts.
ai.translation: No other support than fearlessness is needed, if one acts from an advantageous place after planning everything without any omission.
ai.modern: ஒரு செயலை எஞ்சாமல் முழுமையாகத் திட்டமிட்டு, ஏற்ற இடத்தைத் தேர்ந்தெடுத்துச் செய்தால், அஞ்சாமை ஒன்றைத் தவிர வேறு எந்தத் துணையும் தேவையில்லை.
ai.explanation: This couplet emphasizes the power of choosing the right location for an action. If a person plans their strategy thoroughly without leaving any loopholes (எஞ்சாமை எண்ணி) and executes it from an advantageous position (இடத்தால் செயின்), they do not require any external allies or additional support (துணை வேண்டா). In such a well-planned scenario, the only quality required is inner courage or fearlessness (அஞ்சாமை அல்லால்). The choice of the right place acts as a force multiplier, making the actor self-sufficient.

ai.literal: If he who has a small army reaches a place suitable to go, the morale of him who has a large army will be completely destroyed.
ai.translation: If a leader with a small army reaches a battlefield suited to his strength, the morale of the enemy with a massive army will be utterly shattered.
ai.modern: சிறிய படையை உடையவன் தனக்கு ஏற்ற இடத்தைச் சென்றடைந்தால், பெரிய படையை உடையவனுடைய ஊக்கம் அழிந்துவிடும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme importance of choosing the right location in strategy. Even a commander with a small force can defeat a much larger force if they secure a strategic position that favors them. Once the smaller force occupies this advantageous ground, the confidence and morale of the larger army will collapse, leading to their defeat. The word 'உறு' here means large or abundant, contrasting with 'சிறு' (small), showing that strategic positioning overcomes numerical superiority.

ai.literal: Even if they do not have fortress goodness and greatness, to oppose adversaries with their dwelling land is difficult.
ai.translation: Even if adversaries lack strong fortresses and great resources, it is difficult to defeat them when they are in their own home territory.
ai.modern: அரண் வலிமையும் சிறப்பும் இல்லாதவர்களாக இருந்தாலும், பகைவர்கள் வாழ்கின்ற சொந்த நிலத்திற்குச் சென்று அவர்களை வெல்வது கடினம்.
ai.explanation: This couplet emphasizes the strategic advantage of home territory in conflict. Even if adversaries do not possess strong defensive fortifications or great resources, they retain a natural strength by being in their own familiar dwelling place. Attempting to attack or conquer them on their own ground is extremely difficult. A wise leader must therefore respect the power of location and avoid engaging enemies in their home territory.

ai.literal: In muddy ground where its legs sink, a jackal will kill a male elephant that has faced fearless spear-wielding warriors.
ai.translation: Even a jackal can kill a mighty male elephant, which has faced fearless spear-wielding warriors on the battlefield, if it gets trapped in deep muddy ground where its legs sink.
ai.modern: அஞ்சாத வேல் ஏந்திய வீரர்களைத் தன் முகத்தால் எதிர்த்து நின்ற ஆண் யானையை, அதன் கால் ஆழப் புதையும் சேற்று நிலத்தில் மாட்டித் தவிக்கும்போது, ஒரு நரியும் கொன்றுவிடும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet illustrates the supreme importance of choosing the right place for action. A mighty male elephant is incredibly powerful and can easily face brave warriors armed with spears on a dry battlefield. However, if that same elephant enters a swamp or muddy ground where its heavy legs sink, its immense strength becomes useless. In such a helpless position, even a weak animal like a jackal can easily overpower and kill it. Thus, the couplet teaches that even the most powerful person will be defeated if they fight in an unfavorable location.
